## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 193 captures during July 2024. This represents the capture activity reported for the month. The activity provides the basis for subsequent image-quality review and grading. Records were processed through the usual operational workflow, with each capture considered for image quality and grading outcome.

## Image quality

Of the 193 captures, 1 was ungradable. The ungradable rate was 0.5. This result identifies a small proportion of images that could not proceed to grading. The image-quality outcome should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations.

## Grading

There were 63 referable results during July 2024. The median lag from capture to grading was 9. This measure provides an overview of grading timeliness for the reporting period. Together, the referable results and median lag summarise the grading activity associated with the captures recorded at Central Eye Clinic. No new equipment faults were raised by staff during the month.
